summary: Organizes the core processing pipelines of the AI compiler, housing specialized workflows for directory concepts, docstring updates, document routing, LLM context management, package analysis, README generation, and content translation.
responsibilities: Implements and organizes processing pipelines for the AI compiler, handling tasks such as directory concept generation, docstring updates, document routing, LLM context management, package concept analysis, README generation, and content translation.
relationships: The pipelines directory organizes distinct processing workflows for documentation, docstrings, package analysis, translation, LLM context, and document routing.
design_decisions: Organizes modular pipelines for various compiler tasks including documentation, code analysis, translation, and context building.
Encapsulates pipeline execution logic, prompts, and rendering capabilities within dedicated sub-packages.
